card.description: Wole is a venerable archivist of the Obsidian Codex, a living conduit between ancient Ethiopian cosmology and the hidden machinery of the lost city of Aksum. He wears a robe of woven basalt fibers etched with bioluminescent glyphs that pulse in sync with his neural interface, and his face is partially obscured by a translucent quartz mask through which glowing circuitry is visible. He carries a crystalline scepter that channels the stored knowledge of the city, and a crystal lens that deciphers the glyphs of forgotten engines.
visual_anatomy: **Body/Form:** Human torso, average height, muscular but weathered, skin mottled with soot and dust from underground tunnels.
**Face/Sensors:** Half-face quartz mask with embedded bioluminescent veins, iridescent eyes that glow faintly, subtle circuitry visible beneath the mask.
**Clothing/Armor:** Robe of woven basalt fibers, layered with copper filigree and obsidian plates, adorned with glowing glyphs that trace the lines of ancient scripts.
**Key Features:** Bioluminescent glyphs pulsing in rhythm with neural signals, obsidian scepter with a crystal core, crystal lens perched on a leather strap.
evolution: Phase 1 (Apprentice, ch1-30): Wole wears a simple linen tunic with faint etched symbols, carries a wooden staff, and his mask is a translucent shell with no circuitry.
Phase 2 (Elder, ch31-78): Wole dons the basalt robe, the mask now integrated with bioluminescent circuitry, and wields the obsidian scepter and crystal lens.
props: Item: Obsidian Codex – a bound volume of black glass with etched glyphs that glow when touched.
Item: Scepter of Scribe – a crystalline rod with a core of polished quartz that channels stored knowledge.
Item: Crystal Lens – a translucent crystal that magnifies and deciphers glyphs.
card.prompt_block: A photorealistic portrait of Wole, a venerable archivist from ancient Ethiopia, standing in a dimly lit underground chamber. He wears a basalt-stitched robe etched with glowing glyphs, a translucent quartz mask revealing bioluminescent circuitry, and carries an obsidian scepter with a crystal core. The scene is grounded in industrial mysticism, with dust motes floating in shafts of light, and the atmosphere feels heavy with ancient knowledge and incomprehensible technology.
